song.name: The Awakening
song.plot: The Underworld's soul-pool hits critical mass; Nyktoros, the sleeping god, wakes and breaches the planar barrier. The first dark breath of the Great Darkness. The Legion of Souls gathers in the shadow. Villain-establishing epic of the album.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: Nyktoros / the Void itself — the "I" is Nyktoros. Story beat: the Underworld (deepest stratum of Nythoria) reaches critical shadow-energy, the sleeping god wakes, the planar barrier tears, the Legion of Souls is named, "the black sun" rises, the Void hungers for light. Anchors: the Underworld, critical mass, the Legion of Souls, the planar barrier tearing, the black sun, the Void's hunger. No Rift (Vorgos opens it later), no Anya, no Vorgos, no Eldoria, no Seraphina/Valen, no specific battle. Structure: Verse 1 → Chorus → Verse 2 → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus → Outro; slow build to anthemic. Title track shares its name with the album intentionally. Suggested Suno direction: dark, monumental, slow build to anthemic — low choir, tolling bells, sub-bass, rising intensity.

section.name: Verse 1
section.reworked: Beneath the lowest weight of Nythoria, Where light has never fallen and never will, The banked and buried souls begin to fill, And the deep begins to breathe again.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The Awakening, the black sun calls, The barrier tears, the shadow falls. The Legion of Souls hears the name, And the Void awakens to its flame.

section.name: Verse 2
section.reworked: A hunger older than the farthest star, That drank the light and kept the darkness warm. The planar barrier splits before its arm, And the deep begins to breathe again.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The Awakening, the black sun calls, The barrier tears, the shadow falls. The Legion of Souls hears the name, And the Void awakens to its flame.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: First breath of the endless dark, First step of the final reign. Every light that ever was Is a feast I shall attain.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The Awakening, the black sun calls, The barrier tears, the shadow falls. The Legion of Souls hears the name, And the Void awakens to its flame.

section.name: Outro
section.reworked: The Awakening... the black sun calls... The Awakening... the shadow falls...
